description.value: The Tidemark Theatre is a heritage art deco performing arts venue built in 1946, seating 467 people in downtown Campbell River on Northern Vancouver Island. Originally the Van Isle Theatre, it was purchased by the City of Campbell River in 1985 and is one of seven heritage sites proposed for designation. It presents a year-round mix of touring concerts, comedy, dance recitals, and community performances, and also houses an on-site art gallery.
